name: Catharine Trotter Cockburn
shortBio: English philosopher, novelist, and dramatist; mounted the foremost defense of Locke's epistemology, formulating an early moral realist natural-law theory grounding moral obligation in human nature and social fitness.
centralQuestion: Can moral obligation be demonstratively proven from the real relations and social nature of human beings within an empirical epistemology, without collapsing into theological voluntarism?

keyWorks.title: A Defence of the Essay of Human Understanding
keyWorks.description: Brilliant systematic defense of John Locke's epistemology against theological charges of skepticism and materialism.

keyWorks.title: Remarks upon the Principles and Reasonings of Dr. Rutherforth's Essay
keyWorks.description: Moral philosophical work grounding ethics in the objective fitness of things and Samuel Clarke's rational realism.
